helpPage.walletDesc: Engeza imali, buyekeza okwenziwayo, landa imibiko ye-wallet, futhi uxhumane nosekelo lwemibuzo yokukhokha.
helpPage.checklist1: Qinisekisa ukuxhumeka kwakho kwe-inthanethi futhi uvuselele uhlelo lokusebenza ngaphambi kokubika inkinga yokulayisha.
helpPage.checklist2: Gcina isithombe-skrini sakamuva, isikhathi esiqondile, kanye negama lesikrini lilungile uma uxhumana nosekelo.
helpPage.checklist3: Ngezinkinga zekhamera, umbhobho, isaziso, nendawo, hlola izimvume zohlelo lokusebenza lwedivayisi kuqala.
helpPage.checklist4: Ezindabeni zokukhokha, faka idethi, inani, isimo sokwenziwe, nebhalansi yesikhwama semali eboniswe ohlelweni lokusebenza.
helpPage.aiChatNotReplyDesc: Hlola ukuxhumeka kwakho kwe-inthanethi, zama ukuthumela umlayezo omfushane, bese uvule kabusha ingxoxo ye-AI ukusuka kudeshibhodi. Uma isahluleka, yabelana ngesithombe-skrini sephutha kanye nosekelo.

helpPage.callNotConnectingDesc: Qiniseka ukuthi umeluleki wamukele ingxoxo/isikhathi sakho, bobabili abasebenzisi baku-inthanethi, futhi izimvume zemakrofoni/ikhamera zivunyelwe.

privacyPage.title: Inqubomgomo Yobumfihlo
